description.text: One of the two second expansions of the Sun & Moon series, released together with Alolan Moonlight on 17 March 2017, with more new Pokémon of the Alola region. Tapu Koko, guardian deity of Melemele Island, and Lycanroc in its Midnight Form appear on the two wrappers, and many of the Pokémon-GX are Basic Pokémon that can be played at once. Islands Await You holds Tapu Koko-GX, Alolan Ninetales-GX, Turtonator-GX and Kommo-o-GX. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 50, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX and Hala, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Field Blower, Max Potion and Lightning Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Guardians Rising in May 2017.
